data.body:
[P2] Check child outcomes before applying legacy error classification

The reconstructed cause now reflects the sender's error type, so these checks no longer establish which operation failed. An external callback failure with `ErrorType="aws_durable_execution_sdk_python.exceptions.StepError"` now raises `CallbackSubmitterError` despite a successful submitter; a sender type matching `CallbackTimeoutError` similarly turns an external failure into a timeout. This bypasses the correct exception handlers on both live execution and replay. Consult the child checkpoint statuses first and retain class-based classification only as a fallback when child evidence is unavailable. Add regression cases for sender types matching SDK exception names.
